overview: fork() naya child process banata hai. n forks me total processes 2^n, children 2^n - 1. Conditional forks aur wait/print output bhi aate hain.
coreConcept: Each fork() doubles the number of processes (parent + child both continue after it).
hinglishExplanation: fork() ke baad parent aur child dono agle statement se chalte hain. Isliye k unconditional forks ke baad total processes 2^k. Child process ko copy of memory milti hai (isliye a = a+5 sirf child me dikhega, parent me nahi).
formalDefinition: Each fork() doubles the number of processes (parent + child both continue after it).
importantProperties: k sequential fork() (no conditions): total 2^k, new children 2^k - 1.
Loop me n baar fork: total 2^n, children 2^n - 1.
fork returns 0 in child, child pid in parent, -1 on failure.
Child ko parent memory ki copy milti hai; virtual addresses same dikh sakte hain.
wait() parent ko child ke end tak rok deta hai.
Conditional fork: sirf un iterations me count badhta hai jahan condition true.
commonPitfalls: Children aur total processes me confuse.
Loop me child bhi loop chalata hai, ye bhoolna.
